description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Notify the lands acquired in Girakaduwa, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Asgiriya Village, Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District and Ja-ela, Ja-ela D/S Division Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land allotments) for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger Types 1-3 classification.
